messages:
jon: Quick heads-up — kicking off a priv access rationalization next week. Need an inventory of who has admin/oncall roles + KMS decrypt on prod keys. Ping if you can help.
maya: I can pull the KMS bindings dump. prefer to trim service accounts first, then human entitlements.
tessa: @jon can you share the scope? full org or just infra services?
jon: Start with prod projects + infra svc accounts. We'll expand if low risk. Goal: remove unneeded decrypt permissions, and eliminate any broad "roles/owner" on service accounts.
leo: Any recent incidents driving this or routine? curious about urgency.
jon: Routine cadence but a vuln scan flagged one long-lived deploy key with owner perms -> higher priority. Also want to close gaps before quarterly audit.
audit-bot: Automated report: 1841204000 - KMS key redwood-prod-ml-key has 7 principals with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter. See /audit/reports/1841204000
maya: grabbing that report now. quick note: one principal is svc-ml-batch@redwood, used by the nightly batch job.
tessa: We should create a temporary least-priv role for the batch job if we remove decrypt from svc account. Avoid broad owner -> use roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on the key only.
leo: For testing, prefer a canary: create a restricted key ring and test the job before mass changes.
jon: Agreed. Plan proposal:
- Day 0: inventory and map owners -> who uses what (2 days)
- Day 3: create canary restricted roles + rotate target key to force validation (1 day)
- Day 4-7: staged removals with 24h rollback windows and smoke tests
- Day 8: update runbooks + close entitlements
maya: I'll export bindings. command I'm using:
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ml-key --keyring=prod --location=global --project=redwood-prod --format=json
```
jon: Perfect. Also add a logging filter to capture decrypt attempts during the window:
```
gcloud logging read "protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\" AND resource.labels.key_id:ml-key" --project=redwood-prod --limit=1000
```
leo: For RBAC changes, can we automate PRs to the terraform modules? Otherwise manual edits will slip through.
tessa: I can prototype an automation to create infra PRs that modify bindings and add a test job that runs the smoke tests.
sre-ops: Heads-up: if we rotate keys, downstream caches may fail for a bit. We'll coordinate maintenance windows.
jon: Good call. We'll mark maintenance for the canary rotation and notify on-call + support.
maya: One more: vuln triage item #VULN-2024-332 references credential exposure in repo. I found a related service account with high perms. I'll open a ticket and mark it blocked until we finish the initial prune.
jon: Thanks. Action items assigned:
- maya: export KMS bindings + create CSV mapping (by EOD)
- tessa: build infra-PR prototype for role changes (start tomorrow)
- leo: set up logging filters and canary key ring (tomorrow)
- sre-ops: schedule maintenance window for rotation (coordinate with support)
- jon: draft communication notice for product & support teams (today)

maya: ETA for CSV is 6pm PST. will include service account last-used times where available.
tessa: I'll try to have a PoC PR by EOD tomorrow, if not early Monday.
leo: logging filters up in my sandbox. will share query and a short runbook to interpret decrypt logs.
jon: thanks all. If anyone sees a sudden spike in decrypt failures once we start, ping #eng-oncall and me directly. I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a quick sync tomorrow 10am PT.
maya: :thumbsup:
leo: :eyes:
audit-bot: Scheduled follow-up scan set for 1841280000 to verify dropped entitlements.
sre-ops: noted — will prep rollback steps and a verification checklist.
jon: Closing loop — we'll keep the changes gradual. If anything looks risky, we abort and revert. Everyone good?
maya: good
leo: good
tessa: good
sre-ops: good
